abstract: OBJECTIVE: The purpose of our study was to investigate the potential role of MRI in the preoperative characterization of the histologic type of testicular tumors and, more specifically, to differentiate seminomatous from nonseminomatous testicular neoplasms. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Twenty-one patients with histologically proven germ cell testicular tumors underwent MRI of the scrotum on a 1.5-T unit. T2- and T1-weighted sequences before and after i.v. administration of gadolinium chelate were performed. MRI studies were retrospectively reviewed by two radiologists and findings were correlated with the histopathologic diagnosis. An attempt was made to differentiate seminomatous from nonseminomatous testicular tumors on the basis of signal intensity and homogeneity of the lesions, presence of fibrovascular septa, tumor encapsulation, and patterns of contrast enhancement. Interobserver agreement was assessed using weighted kappa statistics. RESULTS: MRI findings correctly characterized 19 (91%) of 21 testicular neoplasms (nine seminomatous and 10 nonseminomatous testicular tumors), with excellent interobserver agreement. The presence of an intratesticular lesion of predominantly low signal intensity on T2-weighted images, with septa enhancing more than tumor tissue after contrast material administration, was more suggestive for the diagnosis of a seminoma. Tumors that were markedly heterogeneous both on unenhanced and contrast-enhanced images were indicative of a nonseminomatous neoplasm. CONCLUSION: Our study shows that MRI provides a credible preoperative differentiation of seminomatous from nonseminomatous testicular tumors, with excellent interobserver agreement.
abstract_ja:
目的：精巣腫瘍の術前における組織型の評価、特にセミノーマと非セミノーマの鑑別におけるMRIの役割を検討する。

対象と方法：組織学的に確定した精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者21例に対し、1.5T装置で陰嚢のMRIを施行した。T2強調像およびT1強調像を、ガドリニウム造影剤の静脈内投与前後で撮像した。MRI所見は2名の放射線科医が後方視的に読影し、病理組織診断と照合した。信号強度と病変の均一性、線維血管性隔壁の有無、腫瘍被膜の有無、造影パターンに基づいて、セミノーマと非セミノーマの鑑別を試みた。読影者間の一致度は重み付きκ統計量で評価した。

結果：MRI所見により21例中19例(91%)の精巣腫瘍(セミノーマ9例、非セミノーマ10例)を正しく診断できた。読影者間の一致度は極めて良好であった。T2強調像で主に低信号を示す精巣内病変で、造影剤投与後に隔壁が腫瘍実質より強く造影される場合は、セミノーマが示唆された。非造影像および造影像の両方で著明に不均一な腫瘍は、非セミノーマを示唆する所見であった。

結論：MRIは、セミノーマと非セミノーマの精巣腫瘍を術前に信頼性高く鑑別でき、読影者間の一致度も極めて良好である。
